_comment: Thresholds sit just above what production actually measures, to catch NEW regressions.
Ratchet them DOWN as the site improves; never up.
Measured against live production 2026-08-31, after hero videos were re-encoded
(95 MB -> 35 MB of .webm) and moved behind BackgroundVideo.astro, which only attaches
the source on large viewports with no reduced-motion/save-data preference. Lighthouse
audits with mobile emulation, so it downloads no video at all.
total:size    max 1503 KB (was 9.98 MB)   -> cap 1800 KB
accessibility 0.93-0.97, seo 0.92         -> both stay strict at 0.9
The performance floor is 9 points below the observed minimum on purpose: Lighthouse
scores are noisy on CI runners. Tighten it once a few real runs show the actual spread.
NEXT TARGETS: /projects carries ~1.4 MB of images, now the heaviest page by far.
best-practices sits at 0.79 on every page - likely the missing Strict-Transport-Security
header, which is why it is a warning rather than an error.
